mapper.sql: id, project_id, character_code, name, role_type, gender, age_description, appearance, personality, background_story, note, current_state_json, life_status, status, created_at, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO story_character (project_id, character_code, name, role_type, gender, age_description, appearance, personality, background_story, note, current_state_json, life_status, status) VALUES (#{projectId}, #{characterCode}, #{name}, #{roleType}, #{gender}, #{ageDescription}, #{appearance}, #{personality}, #{backgroundStory}, #{note}, #{currentStateJson}, #{lifeStatus}, #{status})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM story_character WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND character_code = #{characterCode} FOR UPDATE
SELECT FROM story_character WHERE project_id = #{projectId} ORDER BY CASE role_type WHEN 'MALE_LEAD' THEN 0 ELSE 1 END, id
SELECT FROM story_character WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND role_type = 'MALE_LEAD' LIMIT 1
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM story_character WHERE project_id = #{projectId} AND character_code = #{characterCode}
